source_snapshot.procedure: Login BMC GUI; inspect System, Processor, Memory, BaseBoard, Power, Thermal, PCIE Device, Storage and Network Adapters; check all information.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; uses truncated `ipmitool fru print | head -n 60` plus operator GUI review, which cannot cover all nine categories.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; requires full GUI evidence, complete supported API data, expected topology and reconciliation.

old_problem: The DeepSeek FRU subset is truncated and cannot represent processor, thermal, PCIe, storage and network categories. 'Correct' lacked a BOM/topology oracle, but those are project configuration rather than unresolved command semantics.
disposition_reason: The source names every required category and the operation is read-only. ED-06/13/15/20 allow the expected populated topology, mandatory/optional fields and unsupported-category representation as project inputs, but require authentic GUI evidence. Complete Redfish/IPMI data may corroborate and automate comparison; it cannot replace the nine GUI surfaces.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2230, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2231 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00013-V001 / d955d71c1a9f7711 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Preserve GUI coverage for System, Processor, Memory, BaseBoard, Power, Thermal, PCIE Device, Storage and Network Adapters; no category may be inferred from a generic FRU list.
Bind the exact BMC/SUT/firmware and signed BOM/topology with stable slot/serial/model identities, mandatory/optional fields and approved empty/unsupported representation.
Capture complete timestamped GUI pages/DOM for every category; do not crop away records or use a truncated `head` pipeline.
Collect complete supported Redfish/IPMI resources as corroboration and map each field to the same physical component.
Report missing, duplicate, stale, unreadable, wrong-slot and cross-surface disagreements separately; mere readability is not correctness.
Read-only only; no FRU/inventory edit, threshold/power change or log clear.
No login, GUI/API read, inventory mutation, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Nine-category BMC GUI system inventory and topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify that every source-named BMC GUI inventory category is readable, complete and correct for the intended SUT's signed populated topology, with supported read-only API corroboration and real visual evidence.
required_package: Exact BMC/SUT firmware and signed BOM/topology
Mandatory/optional field and stable slot/serial/model matrix for all nine categories
BMC GUI access and supported Redfish/IPMI resource mapping
Trusted protected access and evidence/redaction policy
test_case.test_command: Authenticate read-only to the verified BMC, capture complete timestamped GUI/DOM evidence for System, Processor, Memory, BaseBoard, Power, Thermal, PCIE Device, Storage and Network Adapters, collect complete mapped Redfish/IPMI inventory, and reconcile every component/field to the signed topology without truncation or mutation.
test_case.expected_result: All nine GUI categories are readable and contain the complete expected mandatory inventory with correct stable identities/locations; approved optional or unsupported representations match the matrix, and API corroboration has no unexplained mismatch, duplicate or stale record.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete real GUI evidence for all nine categories and deterministic per-component agreement with the signed topology. Missing/unreadable/duplicate/stale/wrong-slot data, unapproved unsupported category or unexplained GUI/API mismatch is FAIL. Missing BOM/mapping blocks execution, not review resolution.
safety_gate: Verify GUI/API evidence belongs to the same BMC/SUT and protect credentials/device identifiers.
Read-only views/GETs only; no FRU edit, threshold/power change or log clear.
No truncation; stop on wrong system, incomplete category coverage, stale/unmapped data or access failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC/SUT/firmware and signed BOM/topology
Complete timestamped GUI screenshot/DOM evidence for all nine named categories
Per-component stable identity/location/field mapping and match result
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On wrong target, incomplete data or access failure, close the session, preserve evidence and do not edit inventory or reset services to manufacture freshness.

source_conflict.reason: The row coherently lists nine GUI inventory categories; correctness requires a project topology oracle but is not contradictory.

blocked.reason: The GUI surfaces and read-only comparison method are clear; topology and mappings are parameterizable.

pending.unlock_condition: Publish the signed nine-category topology/field matrix and access mapping; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.
